name: select
prompt: A small glass vial being lifted off a wooden shelf, brief delicate clink.

name: deselect
prompt: A small glass vial being set back down gently on a wooden shelf, soft muted clink.

name: pour-start
prompt: Liquid beginning to pour from one glass vessel into another, rising watery glug.

name: pour-end
prompt: The last drops of liquid trickling into a glass vessel with a soft splash.

name: invalid
prompt: A dull wooden thunk, a knuckle tapping a corked flask once.

name: layer-complete
prompt: A bright crystal chime with a short shimmering resonance, a small spell completing.

name: win
prompt: A short celebratory sparkle of small bells and chimes rising together, magical triumph.

name: fail
prompt: A soft descending two-note droop on a wooden marimba, gentle disappointment.

name: undo
prompt: A quick reversed whoosh of air, like a book page being flipped backward.

name: ui
prompt: A very short soft interface tick, a fingertip tap on polished wood.

name: hint
prompt: Two delicate glass-bell pings chiming softly, a gentle idea arriving.

name: tick
prompt: A single short clockwork tick, a small wooden metronome click.

name: achievement
prompt: A warm bright brass bell struck once, followed by a rising shimmer of tiny glass chimes, a reward being granted in a quiet workshop.

name: time-warning
prompt: Three quick urgent taps of a fingernail on a crystal vial, a clear tense warning ping, close-miked.

name: new-best
prompt: A bright ascending three-note glockenspiel arpeggio with a soft sparkling tail, a personal record celebrated.
